''A ship with conspicuous pirate markings is orbiting a nearby moon, broadcasting a simple message claiming to have equipment available for sale.''
# Hail the ship.
#* ''The ship responds "Yes, we have an extensive stock! Come aboard and see our wares!"''
#*# Dock with the ship.
#*#* ''A human in an exquisite suit meets you on board. "Welcome to my ship! We specialize in drones of all kinds, can I interest you in any?''
#*#*# Buy some Drone parts. &nbsp;[ {{Transaction|25|subtract_scrap}} ]
#*#*#* You receive {{Transaction|5|add_drones}}.
#*#*# Buy a Drone schematic. &nbsp;[ {{Transaction|25-35|subtract_scrap}} ] &nbsp;<span style="color:grey;">[ the actual trade offer is shown prior to making the choice ]</span>
#*#*#* You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">drone schematic</span>.
#*#*# Buy nothing.

#*#*# Buy Drone Control system upgrade. &nbsp;<span style="color:grey;">(the system must be already installed)</span>
#*#*#* {{Transaction|15-20|subtract_scrap}} for <span style="color:limegreen">Drone Control</span> at level 2-3.
#*#*#* {{Transaction|25-33|subtract_scrap}} for <span style="color:limegreen">Drone Control</span> at level 4-5.
#*#*#* {{Transaction|50-65|subtract_scrap}} for <span style="color:limegreen">Drone Control</span> at level 6-7.
